items.FR-001 (Global Temporal Context Switchin: Strictly dispatch React Context state via isolated context Provider. Emits XHR requests without `window.location.reload()`.
items.FR-010 (UI Race Condition & State Lockin: Injects `z-index: 9999` blocking overlay upon 'Export PDF' click. Timeout hardcoded via `AbortController(15000)` forcing failure if RPC does not resolve.
items.FR-005 (Time-Series Line Graphs): Utilize Recharts `ResponsiveContainer`. Renders SVG paths purely from API-provided aggregated buckets to avoid heavy browser DOM manipulation.
items.FR-009 (Growth Color Context): Ternary evaluation mapping: `metric > 0 ? '#4CAF50' : '#F44336'` baked directly into Component style props.

items.FR-006 (RBAC Payload Injection): Guards endpoints with `@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)`. Parses JWT payload injecting `req.user.id` implicitly into MongoDB Service layer parameter structures.
items.FR-002 (PDF Snapshot Generation): HTTP POST endpoint `POST /api/v1/export/pdf`. Serializes parsed Query params and relays them safely via gRPC/HTTP to the Puppeteer Worker architecture.
items.FR-007 (12-Month Hard Limit on Puppeteer: Middleware or ValidationPipe evaluation throwing `new BadRequestException('Temporal span exceeds 365-day safety limit')` if `endDate - startDate > 31536000000ms`.
items.FR-011 (DOM Density Bucket Aggregation): Controller determines mathematical bucket thresholds (e.g. `$dateTrunc` to Month if range == Annually). Client explicitly sends `'X-Timezone-Offset'` headers applied to MongoDB queries to prevent cross-region visual distortion.
items.FR-008 (Currency Serialization): Response DTOs natively apply `Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' }).format(val)` before emitting JSON.
items.NFR (API Throttling): Uses `@nestjs/throttler` strictly enforcing `ttl: 60, limit: 100` to prevent Thundering Herd exhaustion.

items.Background CRM Polling: Executes on Schedule `*/5 * * * *`. Hits external CRM via authenticated WebHook/REST capturing Delta objects where `updated_at > last_successful_sync`.
items.Cache Invalidation Trigger: After confirming `upsertRange` on MongoDB concludes cleanly, broadcasts an explicit `SyncCompleted` EventBus message to force Cache eviction.
items.NFR (DLQ & Fallback Circuit Breaker): If External CRM returns HTTP 503 repeatedly, halts immediately utilizing Axios Retries (Max 3). Logs failures natively without crashing the Node Event Loop.

items.FR-006 (Role Distribution Data Model): Maintains Relational structure identifying hierarchal boundaries (e.g., `role = 'Account Executive'` maps to strictly `owner_id`), completely segregating Security isolation from transient unstructured Sales data in Mongo.

items.FR-003 & 004 (Aggregations): Denormalizes financial streams into Flat Documents natively mapped for ultra-fast Read. Evaluates `<user_id>` restrictions inherently injected by NestJS CQRS.
items.FR-011 (Bucket Aggregation DB Level): Integrates `$dateTrunc` native stages applying dynamic Timezone adjustments parsing UTC `booked_date` strictly according to the requestor's Geo-location.

items.FR-001 (High-Speed Reads): Maps explicit JSON response payloads into `sales:aggregate:yearly:{user_id}`. Enforces sub-50ms responsiveness allowing the UI to instantly flick across modes.
items.Cache Invalidation Procedure: Subscribes natively to the EventBus. Natively runs non-blocking `SCAN 0 MATCH sales:aggregate:* COUNT 100` piped immediately into `UNLINK` batches defending against Single-Thread lockup.

items.Delta Provisioning: Source of truth for financial dimensions. Requires exposing stable `/api/delta` paths allowing our Cron Poller to scrape incrementally updated instances without invoking massive Data Lake dumps.

items.FR-002 (PDF Snapshot): Accepts strictly serialized metrics via RPC. Boots Headless Chrome in strict `--no-sandbox` isolated contexts.
items.NFR (Resource Limitation): Pod constrained to strict 2GB Memory/CPU boundaries mapped via Kubernetes. Session caps rigidly enforced max 5 concurrent rendering jobs to stop End of Month runaway leaks.

items.FR-002 (Export Link Provisioning): Worker transmits Blob to S3. Gateway responds with a temporary securely signed `Presigned URL`.
items.NFR (Object Lifecycle): Explicitly configured Bucket Policies instantly executing secure auto-deletion exactly `24 hours` from file origination to satisfy strict PII Data governance frameworks.
